cc:Work.dc:title: communication-ch2-correlation
cc:Work.dc:description: Energy autocorrelation R_E(tau)=integral x(t+tau) conjugate(x(t)) dt of a centered rectangular pulse from sliding overlap. At tau=+0.4T the comparison pulse shifts left and overlaps on [-0.5T, 0.1T]. A periodic 1010 unipolar rectangular waveform of period 2 Tb uses a centered high level; ck=A/2 sinc(k/2), and its two-sided PSD has impulse weights abs(ck)^2, DC A^2/4, odd harmonic weights A^2/(pi k)^2, and total power A^2/2.
